what_changed: CFPB withdraws its December 2024 Regulation V data broker proposal (89 FR 101402) as of May 15, 2025 and will take no further action on it.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change to current obligations: the proposed treatment of data-broker and credit-header data as consumer reports will not be adopted. Keep existing FCRA and GLBA handling of skip-tracing and contact data.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Were any planned changes to skip-tracing or data-vendor practices made in anticipation of the proposal?
rationale: Withdrawal of a proposal triaged relevant at low confidence (2024-28690); relevance follows that proposal. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
